# Magma

> Magma is a digital art platform featuring collaborative tools, community competitions, and regular product updates for digital artists of all skill levels.

Magma provides a comprehensive suite of digital painting and illustration tools with an active community centered around art competitions, tutorials, and creative collaborations. The platform regularly releases updates introducing new brushes, features, and quality-of-life improvements while partnering with major hardware manufacturers like Wacom and Huion.

## Key Topics

- Digital Art Tools
- Dual Brush Feature
- Art Jams & Competitions
- Product Updates
- Brush Engine
- Wacom Integration
- Collaboration Features
- Pixel Art
- Community Gallery
- Beginner Guides
- New Brushes
- Canvas Tools
- Blend Tool
- Hardware Setup
- Creator Support

- [Magma July 2024 Release](https://magma.com/ko/blog/magma-july-2024-release): July 2024 Magma release with Art Jams improvements and bug fixes
